collection.title: Peugeot 308 Hatchback 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 308 Hatchback 2021 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Peugeot 308 Hatchback 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
